paite: Ngaiin, ka mitin hiai tengteng a muta hi, ka bilin huai a jaa a theisiam ta hi.
english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

paite: Na thei uh, huaimah ken leng ka thei hi: nou sangin ka niamzo kei hi.
english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

paite: Thilbangkimhihthei kiangah thu ka gen mahmah ding, huan Pathian toh houlim ka ut hi.
english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

paite: Himahleh nou jaw juau phuakte na hi ua, a phattuamlou daktolte na hi vek uhi.
english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

paite: Aw na vek un dai sipsip le uchin maw; na pilna uh hi ding hiven.
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

paite: Tuin ka thusut ja un, ka mukte ngetna ngaikhia un.
english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

paite: Pathian adingin diktatloutakin thu na gen ding uam, amah adingin khemhat takin na houlim ding uam?
english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

paite: Ami na zahtak ding uam? Pathian adin na sual ding uam?
english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

paite: Nou a honzonkhiak a hoih hia? ahihkeileh min mi a khem bangin, amah na khem ding uam?
english: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

paite: Nou a honsal mahmah ding, a guka mite na zahtak uleh.
english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

paite: A hoih tungtuannain nou a honlausak kei dia hia, nou tungah a kihtakhuaina a ke kei diam?
english: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, And his dread fall on you?

paite: Na thugen minthangte uh vut paunakte ahi, na kidalnate uh tungman kidalnate ahi.
english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defenses are defenses of clay.

paite: Dai unla, thu ka gen theihna dingin, honomsak maimai un, ka tungah a hongtung ding hongtung heh.
english: “Be silent, leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

paite: Bangdingin ka hain ka sa ka lain, ka khut ah ka koih dia?
english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

paite: Aman honhihlum mahleh, amah ka ngak lai ding: ama ah ka lampite ka kemhoih lailai ding hi.
english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

paite: Hiai leng ka hotdamna ahi ding; pathianlimsaklou mi a maa hongpai lou ding a hih jiakin.
english: This also shall be my salvation, that a godless man shall not come before him.

paite: Ka thugen thanuam takin ja un, ka thuphuan na bil sung uah om hen.
english: Hear diligently my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

paite: Ngai un, tuin ka thu ka bawlhoihtaa; ka diktat ahi chih ka thei hi.
english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

paite: Kei hon kiselpih ding amah kua ahia? kei lah tuin ka dai dia kha ka khah ding hi.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.

paite: Ka tungah thil nih hih kei phot le uchin, huan na mai akipan ka bu kei ding hi.
english: “Only don’t do two things to me; then I will not hide myself from your face:

paite: Kei akipanin gamla ah na khut kai kikin; huan na lauhuainain honlausak ken.
english: withdraw your hand far from me; and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

paite: Huaichiangin honsam lechin, ka hondawng ding; ahihkeileh honpausak inla, hondawng in.
english: Then call, and I will answer; or let me speak, and you answer me.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate leh khelhnate bang ahia? Ka tatlekna leh ka khelhna hontheisakin.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

paite: Bangdia na mai sela na melma dia honbawl na hia?
english: Why hide you your face, and hold me for your enemy?

paite: Singnah mutleng na hihbuai dia hia? buhpawl keu na delh dia hia?
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

paite: Nang lahkei demin thil kha taktak na gelh ngala, ka tuailai thulimlouhnate na honluahsak hi:
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:

paite: Ka khete leng kol na bunsaka, ka lampite tengteng na chiamteh hi; ka khenuai kimah gi na khunga.Mihing jaw thil muat bangin a mangthanga, nget nekgawp puansilh bangin.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

paite: Mihing jaw thil muat bangin a mangthanga, nget nekgawp puansilh bangin.
english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
